description: This file provides support for OVHCloud AI Endpoints for audio transcription, implementing classes and methods to interact with OVHCloud's `/v1/audio/transcriptions` API. It handles configuration, request transformation, response parsing, and error handling, following the OpenAI API standard for compatibility.

classes.name: OVHCloudAudioTranscriptionConfig
classes.description: Configuration class implementing methods for OVHCloud's audio transcription API, supporting parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: List[OpenAIAudioTranscriptionOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of optional parameters supported by OVHCloud's implementation of the OpenAI Whisper API.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters for the API request, filtering only supported params.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for the transcription request based on base URL and other parameters.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns the appropriate exception class for errors encountered during API interaction.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and returns the request headers, including authorization, with optional override.

methods.name: AudioTranscriptionRequestData transform_audio_transcription_request( self, model: str, audio_file: FileTypes, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms the audio file and parameters into the format required for API submission, following OpenAI's multipart form-data structure.

methods.name: TranscriptionResponse transform_audio_transcription_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, )
methods.description: Parses the raw API response, extracting the transcription text and attaching the full JSON response for internal use.
